printable_terrain.color_policy: Top faces sample the saved final colored full model; cut walls use a darkened adjacent terrain color to avoid a separate grey rim, and underside uses neutral print grey.

cut_wall_projection.note: Cut walls are required for watertight land-only models; this metric tracks whether the visible closure wall projects into removed-water cells and creates a rim-like artifact.

printable_terrain.gpx_trace_policy: GPX overlay meshes are not baked into the land-only derived terrain to avoid unsupported/floating trace segments over removed water.
